title: Obtain a joint absence law without multiplying marginal clock probabilities
statement: For the specified full-qubit guarded Markovian model, degree<=D and positive g,kappa, finite-support Lyapunov polynomials plus buffered packing give P_rho[no emissions in S during[0,t]]<=min(1,C^|S|exp(-gamma|S|t))for EVERY initial density matrix. With source delta,a,c,m, C=3delta/a and gamma=c/[3delta(D+1)^(4m+3)]. Arbitrary marked site sets on nonoverlapping chronological slabs compose by conditioning on the actual past state, not by independence or future records. General overlapping windows, physical perturbations, moderate weak-drive constants and a noisy-data threshold are not supplied.

requires: Ideal full-qubit H=sum_z g X_z product_(y~z)(I-n_y), on-site jumps sqrt(kappa)sigma_minus_z, graph degree<=D,g>0,kappa>0
